Two pressure transmitters specifications for Ullage Cleaning System - HTF Pressure Transmitters.
Design pressure: 18 psia and 600°F for PIT 206-12 and PIT 206-18 respectively.
Instrument type: Pressure Transmitter, Gauge Pressure measurement.
Calibration range: 0-25 psig for both transmitters.
Output signal: 4-20 mA + HART with a resistance of 500 Ohm.
Manufacturer: ABB, Model: 266HRH.M.R.R.A.1…L1.B6…..I2……H3.
Special conditions include solar radiation and flushing ring requirements.
Pressure transmitters for Ullage Cleaning System - Water Differential Pressure
Design pressure: 150 LBS, Design temperature: 200 Deg. F
Instrument type: Pressure Transmitter, Type of measurement: Differential Pressure
Accuracy: ± 0.1% Of Calibrated Span, Overpressure: 1.5
Housing: Aluminium, Electrical connection: 1/2" NPT
